name: HkaMetrics
title: HealthKit values without a standard code
description: Codes for Apple HealthKit values that have no correct LOINC code. Values that do have one (steps, heart rate, sleep durations, SpO2, weight and others) use LOINC; see docs/fhir-mapping.md. Each concept states its unit, value type and where the value comes from. Group concepts are not selectable and only organise the codes.

property.description: Group concept; never used as an Observation code.
UCUM unit the value is recorded in. Absent for text values.
FHIR value type: Quantity, SampledData or CodeableConcept (text only).
Where the value comes from: day-folder file or HealthKit field.

concept.definition: Day totals of cumulative HealthKit quantities that have no matching LOINC code.

Energy burned above resting metabolism during the local calendar day: the sum of HKQuantityTypeIdentifierActiveEnergyBurned samples from one source (the source with the largest total, or the configured priority). Estimated by the device. LOINC 41979-6 is total calories, not active.

Resting energy for the local calendar day: the sum of HKQuantityTypeIdentifierBasalEnergyBurned from one source. An estimate from body measurements, not a measured metabolic rate (so not LOINC 69429-9).

Apple's Exercise ring minutes for the local calendar day: minutes of movement at or above a brisk walk, as judged by Apple Watch. Not split into moderate and vigorous, so LOINC 77592-4 / 77593-2 do not apply.
Distance cycled during the local calendar day, from one source.
Heart-rate values that no LOINC code describes correctly.

Mean of all heart-rate samples (every source) that start in each minute of the local day; one slot per minute (1440, or 1380/1500 on daylight-saving days), E where there is no sample. Not coded LOINC 8867-4: the vital-signs heart-rate profile allows only a Quantity value.
Sleep stages that LOINC has no code for.
Minutes recorded as HKCategoryValueSleepAnalysis.inBed for the night ending on this day, from the chosen sleep source. In bed is not asleep; it can overlap the stage minutes.

Minutes recorded as HKCategoryValueSleepAnalysis.asleepUnspecified (asleep, with no stage) for the night ending on this day. Sources without stage tracking (older watches, phones, many third-party apps) write only this.
Workout figures without a LOINC code.
Total distance of the workout: the largest of its distance statistics (walking/running, cycling, swimming, and so on), converted to metres.
Voltage samples of an Apple Watch ECG, similar to limb lead I, in microvolts at the recorded sampling frequency (period = 1000 / Hz ms). E marks a missing sample.
Apple's classification of the recording, as the HKElectrocardiogram.Classification case name (sinusRhythm, atrialFibrillation, inconclusiveLowHeartRate, ...). A screening result, not a diagnosis.
Cardio-fitness values without a correct LOINC code.
Maximal oxygen uptake as estimated by the device (Apple Watch cardio fitness). LOINC 60842-2 is VO2 (oxygen consumption), not VO2 max.
